metric_caveat: Activity uses retained Postfix logs, capped at 20,000 entries and filtered to the last 24 hours. Retention can cover less time. Queue IDs count messages; deliveries and failures count recipient attempts. Local deliveries can include internal mail. Service health is captured when the page loads.
